{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Lithuania|Cuisine of Lithuania]]

'''Kugelis''', also called '''''bulvių plokštainis''''' (literally "flat potato dish") or '''''banda''''', is a [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Lithuania|Lithuanian]] baked potato pudding. Its main ingredients are potatoes, bacon, milk, onions, and eggs. It may be spiced with salt, black pepper, [[Cookbook:Bay Leaf|bay leaves]], and/or [[Cookbook:Marjoram|marjoram]]. It is usually eaten with sour cream and/or crumbled fried fat white bacon (''spirgai'').

==Ingredients==
*5 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]], peeled and [[Cookbook:Grater|grated]] (or ground with a [[Cookbook:Food Processor|food processor]]) 
*2 medium [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]], grated 
*1 lb [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]], [[Cookbook:Frying|fried]] and crumbled (reserve about ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] drippings) 
*1 stick (8 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]]) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], melted 
*6 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
*1 large can [[Cookbook:Evaporated milk|evaporated milk]]
*4 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*[[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]] to taste (about 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]])
 
==Procedure==
# Combine the grated potatoes and onions.
# [[Cookbook:Frying|Fry]] and crumble bacon. Add to the potato mixture along with ¼ cup bacon fat. Mix well.
# [[Cookbook:Beating|Beat]] the eggs, and stir in the evaporated milk, melted butter, salt, and pepper.
# Mix the egg mixture into the potato mixture.
# Pour into a well-greased 9x13-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] [[Cookbook:Cake Pan|cake pan]]—it should just barely fit.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] at 350°F (175°C) for 90 minutes.
# [[Cookbook:Slicing|Slice]] into squares, and top with [[Cookbook:Sour Cream|sour cream]] or [[Cookbook:Applesauce|applesauce]].

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Leftovers are best reheated sliced thin and [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sautéed]] in melted butter. Kugelis also reheats well in the [[Cookbook:Microwave Oven|microwave]] and freezes well.
* Do not drain the liquid from the potatoes and onions.
